name: Impero A/S
summary: Impero A/S is a company that develops and offers a cloud-hosted software-as-a-service (SaaS) solution. This platform is designed to empower organizations in achieving and maintaining compliance, achieved by streamlining and automating processes such as risk and control management, record-keeping, ensuring system scalability, and generating insightful reports. Impero A/S was founded in 2013 and has its corporate headquarters located in Åbyhøj, Denmark.
